sources.title: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct is an 8-billion-parameter language model from Meta optimized for dialogue and instruction-following tasks. The model features a 131,072-token context window, supports tool use and multilingual capabilities, and is available through multiple providers at varying price points.
